ValidationRule.description: Drive Start Time must be before End Time and vice versa
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(sked_End_Time__c), ISCHANGED(sked_Start_Time__c) ), TIMEVALUE(sked_End_Time__c) <= TIMEVALUE(sked_Start_Time__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Drive End Time must be after the Drive Start Time
